tools.name: textus_get_profile
tools.description: Get the profile of the user who owns the API token, including account memberships and roles. TextUs API: GET /profile.

tools.name: textus_list_accounts
tools.description: List the TextUs accounts the user belongs to, with phone numbers and role. Most other tools need an account `slug` from here. TextUs API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: textus_get_account
tools.description: Get one account by slug: name, phone numbers, type and links. TextUs API: GET /accounts/{account}.

tools.name: textus_list_account_users
tools.description: List the users who belong to an account. TextUs API: GET /{account}/users.

tools.name: textus_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts of an account in alphabetical order. Use `q` to search by name or phone number. Pass a saved `contact_filter` slug for a saved view (default `all`). TextUs API: GET /{account}/contact_filters/{filter}/contacts.

tools.name: textus_list_contact_filters
tools.description: List the saved contact filters (views) of an account. TextUs API: GET /{account}/contact_filters.

tools.name: textus_get_contact
tools.description: Get all known data about one contact: name, phone numbers, custom data and tags. TextUs API: GET /contacts/{contact}.

tools.name: textus_list_contact_notes
tools.description: List the notes users wrote about a contact. TextUs API: GET /contacts/{contact}/notes.

tools.name: textus_list_conversation_filters
tools.description: List the conversation filters (inbox views such as unread, mine, closed) of an account, with unread counts. TextUs API: GET /{account}/conversation_filters.

tools.name: textus_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations in an inbox view, newest message first. Use filter `search` with `q` (a phone number or text) to find a conversation. TextUs API: GET /{account}/conversation_filters/{filter}/conversations.

tools.name: textus_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation: contact, assigned users, state and last message. TextUs API: GET /conversations/{conversation}.

tools.name: textus_get_conversation_timeline
tools.description: Get the messages and events of a conversation, newest first. Messages include direction, body and delivery state. TextUs API: GET /conversations/{conversation}/timeline.

tools.name: textus_get_conversation_stats
tools.description: Get stats for one conversation: start time, engagement grade and outbound delivery percentage. TextUs API: GET /conversations/{conversation}/stats.

tools.name: textus_list_campaign_filters
tools.description: List the campaign views of an account (for example mine, all). TextUs API: GET /{account}/campaign_filters.

tools.name: textus_list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns (bulk messages) in a campaign view, ordered by scheduled time, with title, body and state. TextUs API: GET /{account}/campaign_filters/{filter}/campaigns.

tools.name: textus_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign: message body, state, schedule and recipient counts. TextUs API: GET /campaigns/{campaign}.

tools.name: textus_get_campaign_analytics
tools.description: Get aggregated statistics (campaigns sent, recipients, delivery) for all campaigns of an account. TextUs API: GET /{account}/campaigns/analytics.

tools.name: textus_list_groups
tools.description: List contact groups in a group folder (`mine` or account groups). Use `q` to search group names. TextUs API: GET /{account}/group_filters/{filter}/groups.

tools.name: textus_list_group_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to a group. TextUs API: GET /groups/{group}/contacts.

tools.name: textus_list_opt_outs
tools.description: List phone numbers that opted out of messages for an account. Use `q` for a partial search (3 digits or more). TextUs API: GET /{account}/opt_outs.

tools.name: textus_list_saved_replies
tools.description: List the canned message bodies a user saved. TextUs API: GET /users/{user}/saved_replies.

tools.name: textus_send_message
tools.description: WRITE: sends a REAL SMS from the account's number to one or more recipients. It cannot be undone and is never retried. Show the user the recipients and text first, then call with confirm=true. TextUs API: POST /{account}/messages.

tools.name: textus_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new contact in an account. TextUs API: POST /{account}/contacts.

tools.name: textus_add_contact_note
tools.description: WRITE: adds an internal note to a contact. The contact does not see it. TextUs API: POST /contacts/{contact}/notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: textus_list_conversation_filters, textus_list_conversations, textus_get_conversation, textus_get_conversation_timeline, textus_list_campaigns, textus_get_campaign, textus_list_opt_outs, textus_list_saved_replies · Private data: textus_get_profile, textus_list_contacts, textus_list_contact_filters, textus_get_contact, textus_list_contact_notes, textus_get_conversation, textus_list_groups, textus_list_group_contacts, textus_create_contact, textus_add_contact_note · Public sink: textus_send_message, textus_create_contact, textus_add_contact_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: textus_list_conversation_filters, textus_list_conversations, textus_get_conversation, textus_get_conversation_timeline, textus_list_campaigns, textus_get_campaign, textus_list_opt_outs, textus_list_saved_replies · Private data: textus_get_profile, textus_list_contacts, textus_list_contact_filters, textus_get_contact, textus_list_contact_notes, textus_get_conversation, textus_list_groups, textus_list_group_contacts, textus_create_contact, textus_add_contact_note · Public sink: textus_send_message, textus_create_contact, textus_add_contact_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
